Hi Marta — great to meet you and thanks for the VAT cert.

Short answers up front: yes, we can accept reverse-charge invoices; we also create a PO and route invoices to our EU buying entity to make VAT handling straightforward.

Next steps / required items from you so we can activate the supplier and issue a PO: 
1) Completed vendor onboarding form (attached as PDF) — please sign the bank details page.
2) Supplier bank confirmation (bank statement or account verification letter).
3) VAT certificate (you attached — thank you).
4) If you are using a fiscal representative for cross-border invoicing, please share their letter of appointment.

Routing options:
- Preferred: Invoice to "Redwood Inference EU B.V." (EU buying entity) without VAT under reverse-charge. We'll create a PO number and provide a PO reference to include on the invoice.
- Alternate: Invoice to Redwood central (US) entity — this creates additional tax paperwork and may delay payment.

ETA: Once we receive the completed onboarding form + bank confirmation, Procurement can issue a PO within 3 business days. Finance will then confirm supplier tax mapping.

Attaching: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and our short supplier VAT instructions for vendors.

Neha Kapoor
Vendor Operations — Redwood Inference
(attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, supplier_vat_instructions.pdf)
